p17's dust and stone wake is visibly anchored to the lower-right step behind Aki's boot, while long directional strokes carry the body and single sword toward the upper-left. The stronger impact burst is centered on one sword-to-spear crossing. This is a readable result of p20's deflection, with the impact effect ending before the quiet panel rather than producing an unintended continuing attack.
